```{r summary_statistics_by_race updated, warning=FALSE, message=FALSE}

# ============================================================================
# TABLE 1: Summary Statistics (Weighted, Raw CPS, Age 18+)
# Updated to reflect Kauffman replication variables + simplified logic
# ============================================================================

library(dplyr)
library(openxlsx)

# -----------------------------
# 1) Small weighted helpers
# -----------------------------
w_mean <- function(x, w) {
  ok <- !is.na(x) & !is.na(w) & w > 0
  if (!any(ok)) return(NA_real_)
  sum(w[ok] * x[ok]) / sum(w[ok])
}

w_sd <- function(x, w) {
  ok <- !is.na(x) & !is.na(w) & w > 0
  if (!any(ok)) return(NA_real_)
  mu <- w_mean(x, w)
  sqrt(sum(w[ok] * (x[ok] - mu)^2) / sum(w[ok]))
}

# -----------------------------
# 2) Build analysis dataframe from RAW cps_data
# -----------------------------
# Strip haven_labelled once, up front — makes everything below simple
df <- cps_data %>%
  as_tibble() %>%
  mutate(across(where(haven::is.labelled), haven::zap_labels)) %>%
  filter(year %notin% c(2020, 2002),
         race %in% c("White Non-Hispanic", "Black Non-Hispanic",
                     "Asian & Pacific Islander Non-Hispanic", "Hispanic"),
         as.numeric(age) >= 18)                                # Age 18+ (updated)

# Pre-join HPI if available
if (exists("cps_df") && "hpi_final" %in% names(cps_df)) {
  df <- df %>%
    left_join(cps_df %>% select(cpsidp, mish, hpi_final),
              by = c("cpsidp", "mish"))
}

# Construct analysis variables in ONE mutate
df <- df %>%
  mutate(
    WEIGHT = wtfinl_annual,

    # Outcome variables
    entrepreneurship2         = as.numeric(entrepreneurship2 == 1),           # main DV (incorporated, 4-month)
    entrepreneurship_kauffman = as.numeric(entrepreneurship_kauffman == 1),   # Kauffman validation

    # Demographics
    female           = as.numeric(sex == 2),
    age              = as.numeric(age),
    married          = as.numeric(marst == 1),
    children_present = as.numeric(nchild > 0),
    nchild           = as.numeric(nchild),
    homeowner        = as.numeric(hhtenure == 1),

    # Race dummies
    white    = as.numeric(race == "White Non-Hispanic"),
    black    = as.numeric(race == "Black Non-Hispanic"),
    hispanic = as.numeric(race == "Hispanic"),
    asianpi  = as.numeric(race == "Asian & Pacific Islander Non-Hispanic"),

    # Education (4 levels from educ_desc, fallback to numeric educ)
    less_hs  = as.numeric(educ_desc == "a - Less than High School" |
                          (is.na(educ_desc) & educ <  73)),
    hs       = as.numeric(educ_desc == "b - High School Graduate" |
                          (is.na(educ_desc) & educ == 73)),
    somecoll = as.numeric(educ_desc %in% c("c - Some College (No Degree)",
                                           "d - College Diploma / Associate Degree") |
                          (is.na(educ_desc) & educ %in% c(80, 81, 90, 91, 92))),
    collegep = as.numeric(educ_desc %in% c("e - College Graduate (Bachelor's)",
                                           "f - Postgraduate") |
                          (is.na(educ_desc) & educ %in% c(100, 110, 111, 120, 121, 122, 123, 124, 125))),

    # Hours worked (Kauffman 15+ filter)
    hours_week     = ifelse(ahrsworkt >= 999, NA_real_, as.numeric(ahrsworkt)),
    works_15plus   = as.numeric(hours_week >= 15),

    # Earnings (clean, convert weekly → yearly)
    earn_week  = ifelse(earnweek2 %in% c(999, 1923, 1000000, 999999.99), NA_real_,
                        as.numeric(earnweek2)),
    yearly_earnings  = ifelse(earn_week * 52 >= 10, earn_week * 52, NA_real_),
    earnings_missing = as.numeric(is.na(yearly_earnings)),

    # HPI (if available)
    hpi10 = if ("hpi_final" %in% names(.)) hpi_final / 10 else NA_real_
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(WEIGHT) & WEIGHT > 0)

cat("=== SAMPLE ===\n")
cat("N (age >= 18, 4 race groups, valid weight):", nrow(df), "\n\n")

# -----------------------------
# 3) Variables to report (label → column name)
# -----------------------------
var_map <- c(
  # Outcomes
  "Entrepreneurship (incorporated, 4-month)"  = "entrepreneurship2",
  "Entrepreneurship (Kauffman, 1-month)"      = "entrepreneurship_kauffman",
  # Race
  "White"                                     = "white",
  "Black"                                     = "black",
  "Hispanic"                                  = "hispanic",
  "Asian/PI"                                  = "asianpi",
  # Demographics
  "Female"                                    = "female",
  "Age"                                       = "age",
  "Married"                                   = "married",
  "Children present"                          = "children_present",
  "Children (count)"                          = "nchild",
  "Homeowner"                                 = "homeowner",
  # Education
  "Less than High School"                     = "less_hs",
  "High School"                               = "hs",
  "Some College"                              = "somecoll",
  "College+"                                  = "collegep",
  # Work
  "Hours worked/week"                         = "hours_week",
  "Works 15+ hrs/week"                        = "works_15plus",
  # Earnings
  "Yearly earnings ($)"                       = "yearly_earnings",
  "Earnings missing"                          = "earnings_missing",
  # HPI
  "HPI (per 10)"                              = "hpi10"
)

# Drop variables that don't exist or are all NA
var_map <- var_map[sapply(var_map, function(v) v %in% names(df) && !all(is.na(df[[v]])))]

# Detect binary variables automatically
is_binary <- function(x) {
  u <- unique(x[!is.na(x)])
  length(u) <= 2 && all(u %in% c(0, 1))
}
binary_vars <- names(var_map)[sapply(var_map, function(v) is_binary(df[[v]]))]

# -----------------------------
# 4) One row per variable (weighted)
# -----------------------------
one_row <- function(label, col, data) {
  x <- data[[col]]
  # Use earnwt_annual for earnings if available, else wtfinl_annual
  w <- if (col == "yearly_earnings" && "earnwt_annual" %in% names(data)) {
    data$earnwt_annual
  } else {
    data$WEIGHT
  }

  ok    <- !is.na(x) & !is.na(w) & w > 0
  miss  <-  is.na(x) & !is.na(w) & w > 0

  data.frame(
    Variable    = label,
    Obs         = sum(ok),
    Weight      = sum(w[ok]),
    Mean        = w_mean(x, w),
    `Std.dev.`  = w_sd(x, w),
    Min         = if (any(ok)) min(x[ok]) else NA_real_,
    Max         = if (any(ok)) max(x[ok]) else NA_real_,
    Missing_N   = sum(miss),
    Missing_Pct = 100 * sum(miss) / (sum(ok) + sum(miss)),
    check.names = FALSE,
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )
}

table1_raw <- bind_rows(lapply(names(var_map), function(lbl) one_row(lbl, var_map[[lbl]], df)))

# -----------------------------
# 5) Format for display (binary → %, earnings → $ comma, rest → 2 decimals)
# -----------------------------
fmt_num     <- function(x, d = 2) formatC(round(x, d), format = "f", digits = d, big.mark = ",")
fmt_dollar  <- function(x) ifelse(is.na(x), "NA", paste0("$", formatC(round(x, 0), format = "d", big.mark = ",")))
fmt_pct     <- function(x) ifelse(is.na(x), "NA",
                            ifelse(x * 100 < 1, sprintf("%.2f%%", x * 100), sprintf("%.0f%%", x * 100)))

table1 <- table1_raw %>%
  mutate(
    Obs         = formatC(Obs, format = "d", big.mark = ","),
    Weight      = formatC(round(Weight), format = "d", big.mark = ","),
    Mean        = case_when(
                    Variable %in% binary_vars          ~ fmt_pct(Mean),
                    Variable == "Yearly earnings ($)"  ~ fmt_dollar(Mean),
                    TRUE                               ~ fmt_num(Mean, 2)),
    `Std.dev.`  = case_when(
                    Variable == "Yearly earnings ($)"  ~ fmt_dollar(`Std.dev.`),
                    TRUE                               ~ fmt_num(`Std.dev.`, 2)),
    Min         = fmt_num(Min, 0),
    Max         = fmt_num(Max, 0),
    Missing_N   = formatC(Missing_N, format = "d", big.mark = ","),
    Missing_Pct = sprintf("%.2f", Missing_Pct)
  )

# -----------------------------
# 6) Export to Excel
# -----------------------------
out_file <- paste0("Table1_SummaryStats_Age18_", Sys.Date(), ".xlsx")

wb <- createWorkbook()
addWorksheet(wb, "Table1")
writeData(wb, "Table1", table1)
freezePane(wb, "Table1", firstRow = TRUE)
setColWidths(wb, "Table1", cols = 1, widths = 42)
setColWidths(wb, "Table1", cols = 2:ncol(table1), widths = 14)
saveWorkbook(wb, out_file, overwrite = TRUE)

cat("=== TABLE 1 COMPLETE ===\n")
cat("N =", nrow(df), "records (age 18+, 4 race groups)\n")
cat("Variables:", nrow(table1), "\n")
cat("Saved to:", out_file, "\n\n")
print(table1)
```
